name: WB AI SEO
author: aiseopro

sections.description:
WB AI SEO helps you create and manage your /llms.txt file — the emerging standard for helping AI systems understand your website.

As more users rely on AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity to find information, having an llms.txt file helps ensure your content is discoverable and properly understood by these systems.

What is llms.txt?

llms.txt is an emerging standard file (similar to robots.txt) that helps AI systems understand your website. Think of it as a sitemap designed specifically for Large Language Models (LLMs).

Key Features

  • Enable/Disable Toggle – Easily turn your llms.txt file on or off
  • Manual Content Editor – Full control over your llms.txt content using Markdown
  • Site Summary – Configure a description that helps AI understand your site
  • Live Preview – Instantly view your llms.txt file at yoursite.com/llms.txt
  • Default Template – Get started quickly with a pre-built template

Why AI SEO Matters

  • ChatGPT has 200M+ weekly active users asking for recommendations
  • Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini are growing rapidly
  • Users increasingly trust AI recommendations over traditional search
  • Early adopters of AI SEO will have a significant competitive advantage

Want More Features?

Check out WB AI SEO Pro for advanced features:

  • AI summaries on posts, pages, and products
  • Auto-generated llms.txt from your content
  • LLM Visibility Score™ for each page
  • WooCommerce product support
  • Priority support

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “WB AI SEO”
  4. Click “Install Now”
  5. Click “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  4. Click “Upload Plugin”
  5. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  6. Click “Activate”

After Installation

  1. Go to WB AI SEO in your WordPress admin menu
  2. Navigate to the Your llms.txt tab
  3. Make sure the llms.txt file is enabled
  4. Edit the content to describe your website
  5. Save your changes
  6. View your llms.txt file at yoursite.com/llms.txt
sections.faq:
What is LLM SEO?

LLM SEO (Large Language Model Search Engine Optimization) is the practice of optimizing your content for AI search engines and assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity. Unlike traditional SEO which focuses on Google rankings, LLM SEO focuses on making your content easily understandable and citable by AI systems.

What is llms.txt?

llms.txt is an emerging standard file that helps AI systems understand your website. It’s similar to robots.txt but designed specifically for AI crawlers. The file contains structured information about your site and key pages in a format that AI systems can easily parse.

How do I format my llms.txt?

The llms.txt file uses Markdown formatting. Start with your site name as a heading (#), include a brief description using blockquote (>), and list your important pages with Markdown links text.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

No. WB AI SEO is extremely lightweight. It only loads styles on admin pages and serves the llms.txt file on-demand with minimal overhead.

Can I use HTML in my llms.txt?

The llms.txt file should be plain text with Markdown formatting. HTML is not recommended as AI systems parse this as plain text.

Does this work with caching plugins?

Yes! The llms.txt file is served dynamically but can be cached by your caching plugin or CDN for optimal performance.
